artifacts.summary: 3-phase plan widening lean-plan-compliance-check.sh's per-name lookup scope to union the resolved Lean source roots with the plan's own harvested Files-to-modify paths and Challenge manifest join, under must-exist polarity only, plus six regression cases and a deploy-tree regeneration.

memory_candidates.content: A bash script's scope-widening change that must work in BOTH the agent-system source store and the deployed .claude/ tree needs a cross-script resolution ladder, not a single sibling-directory default: in the deployed tree two extensions' scripts sit side by side in .claude/scripts/, but in the source store they live in different extension directories (agent-system/extensions/<a>/scripts vs .../<b>/scripts). The precedent shape is lean-comparator-run.sh's env-override-with-sibling-default (${VAR:-$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}")/other.sh}), extended with a repo-relative .claude/scripts/ rung and a ../../<other-ext>/scripts/ rung. Without the source-store rung, a test suite that runs the script straight out of the source store silently exercises the fail-soft fallback instead of the new code path, and passes for the wrong reason.
